provenance.composer: route_to_midi.py, rendered with FluidSynth and the mbgm.SF2 General MIDI soundfont
provenance.mapping: EIC warmth -> melody and pad pitch; daily km -> pulses per beat; wind speed -> tempo; wind vs heading -> interval
provenance.tracking: Recorded daily positions, 2024-2025; departure to return per bird
provenance.temperature: NASA EIC 2026 imagery, sampled at the bird position; a relative visual score, not 2024 weather or calibrated degrees
provenance.wind: Only Nico's 21 ERA5 hours on 30 October 2024, heard in the wind example; the full journeys receive no wind, so tempo stays at the neutral value
